subject: general
question: Which of the following classical dance forms has originated in Andhra Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kuchipudi** is a classical dance form that originated in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It is known for its graceful movements and strong narrative/dramatic character.
 
• This dance form is named after the village of Kuchipudi in the Krishna district of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Kuchipudi is characterized by its fast rhythms, fluid movements, and dramatic storytelling, often depicting scenes from Hindu epics and mythology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak** is a classical dance form that originated in Northern India.
 
• **Bharatnatyam** is a classical dance form from Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Kathakali** is a classical dance-drama from Kerala.
 
• Each of these dance forms has unique characteristics and cultural significance in their respective regions.
